_notes: Recovery Opportunity Score weights and Action Score formula. All sub-scores are normalized 0-100. This is a transparent configurable heuristic, explicitly NOT a calibrated probability or a trained model -- see README for rationale.

recovery_potential_inputs: razorpay_source (customer > gateway > bank, in terms of retry-worthiness)
prior_attempt_count (more prior failed attempts = lower potential)

action_score._naming_note: Deliberately named 'recovery_benefit_estimate', NOT 'expected recovery' or 'predicted rupee recovery' -- it is a normalized, configurable prior used to COMPARE interventions, not a calibrated probability.

_production_roadmap_note: v2 architecture: once (event, action, outcome) triples accumulate from real usage, recovery_potential and recovery_benefit_estimate can be replaced by a calibrated P(recovery | context, action) model with incremental-uplift estimation. v1 deliberately does not train this from synthetic labels -- see README 'Data Honesty' section.
